rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision with a totaled vehicle and bodily injury (whiplash and sprained wrist) resulting from impact damage to the policyholder's car.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday morning at approximately 8:15 AM while stopped at a red light. The vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed; other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
